Subject: Re: Refund for my $49 charge

Hi Dana,

Thanks for writing in, and sorry for the trouble with the Pro monthly charge after you cancelled.

I looked up your USD 49.00 charge from nine days ago. A refund of USD 4.90 has been returned to your original card; the remaining balance toward your full USD 49.00 request has not gone through yet. We're following up with our payment provider to get the rest corrected, and we'll email you an update as soon as we have one. You don't need to do anything right now.

Again, sorry for the inconvenience.

Best,
